tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rje btsun byams pa mgon po la mchod pa'i cho ga dang 'brel bar dga' ldan du sems bskyed pa'i smon lam nor bu'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ gang mtshan byams pa'i bdud rtsis yid can kun// dbugs 'byin mgon po mchog la gus btud nas// dga' ldan chos kyi 'dun sar bgrod pa'i lam// yid 'phrog nor bu'i them skas deng 'dir bskrun// de la grub pa brnyes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi khyā ta de ba la rje btsun byams pas dngos su gnang*/ de la kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dras gsan cing thugs nyams su bzhes te/ khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal la stsal ba'i dga' ldan du sems bskyed pa'i cho ga'i rim pa khyad par du 'phags pa nyams su len par 'dod pas lag tu blang ba'i rim pa la gnyis/ las su bya ba dang*/ smon lam gdab pa'o// dang po ni/ gzhung las/ las su bya ba ni rten byin rlabs can dgod/ mchod pa ci 'byor dbul/ sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ sgom pa gsum po sna tshang ba re cis kyang byed dgos te/ sbyin pa ni bza' btung khab skud la sogs gang 'byor bya ba'o// tshul khrims ni bsnyen gnas zhag 'ga' bsrung ba la sogs pa'o// sgom pa'ang thun mong gi sgom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgom pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ ngo bo rang sems gnyug ma bsgom pa'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i sgom pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gang phyir byams pa de phyir khong khro 'gal// zhes pa la sogs pa dran pas byams chos khyad par du bsgom zhing*/ de'i mi mthun phyogs spong ba'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar lag tu blang ba sngon du 'gro bas/ gnyis pa smon lam gdab pa'i cho ga la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas gtsang zhing dben la yid dang mthun par phyag dar bya zhing*/ dri bzang gi chus chag chag gdab/ gung du mgon po ma pham pa'i snang brnyan gtso bor gyur pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten dgram/

mchod pa g.yo med pas btsal la/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod spyi dang*/ khyad par me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ zhal zas sogs kyi phreng ba tshar du dngar bar bsham/ rang gi mdun du 'bud dkrol brdung gsum gyi rol mo'i bye brag dang*/ khrus chas/ maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa 'du bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'khod de dge sems khyad par can gyis mtshams sbyar te/ skyabs yul nam mkha' gang bar sad pa'i spyan sngar/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ shes rab snying brtse dang bcas pa'i// brtson pas sems can don du bdag /sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi// zhes pas sems bskyed/ gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad la dmigs te sman bla'i mdo chog nas 'byung ba ltar byin rlabs bzhi skor rgyas par bya ba'am/ de tsam mi nus na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong bar gyur pa'i gzhir/ gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa legs pas mdzes shing lhun stug pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khri seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ mtha' skor kun tu seng khri pad zla'i gdan grangs med pa dang*/

phyi nang kun tu'ang cha rigs dang 'tshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang*/ na bza' dang*/ rol mo la sogs pa phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang*/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan bklubs pa dang ldan pa 'byung bar gyur cig thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyam bai ḍūr+ya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /ces dang*/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te sa myak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bid+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa sam̐ kra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis de de bzhin du gyur cig ces bden pa'i stobs brjod/ de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas spos btul zhing snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi pho brang nas dpal rgyal ba byams pa mgon po gser mdog mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyag g.yas thugs kar chos 'chad dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi tshul gyis klu shing gi yal ga'i rtsa ba bzung zhing me tog snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ril ba spyi blugs dang bcas pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi ngos la bstan pa'i bdag po mchod rten gyi rnam pas spras pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing tshangs pa'i skud pa 'chang ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos nam mkha'i lam nas mngon sum du gshegs par mos te/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// ces 'byon legs bya/ khrus gsol ba'i thog mar khrus khang bskyed pa ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// khrus gsol ba ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /ces dang*/ spro na/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa// gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chus// khrus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol// zhes sogs phar phyin drug gi tshigs bcad kyang brjod/

sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// byug pa 'bul ba ni/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// na bza' dang rgyan 'bul ba ni/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi zhing du dgyes bzhin pas brtan par bzhugs par bsam/ de nas gzhung rtsa bar thog mar mchod pa dang*/ de'i rjes su yan lag bdun pa bya bar gsungs na'ang*/ 'dir yan lag bdun gyi khongs su mchod pa bsdus te bya ba'i tshul la/ thog mar dngos su phyag 'tshal ba dang bcas te/ ji snyed su bdag phyogs bcu'i sogs nas/ bdag gis bstod ces pa'i bar bzang spyod nas 'byung ba ltar dang*/ spro na khro phu lo tsā ba chen po sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i byams pa'i bstod pa rgyas par bya/ bsdu na/ byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing bsregs// ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa'i// dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes mang du brjod cing phyag bya/ mchod pa la gzhung las/ thun mong gi longs spyod ci 'byor pa dbul ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rang gi lus dbul ba dang*/ khyad par gyi mchod pa dge ba'i rtsa ba dbul ba'o// zhes gsum du gsungs pa'i dang po ni/

byams pa'i snang brnyan la na bza' sogs ci 'byor pa dbul/ spos dang mar me sogs sbar la/ dngos su bshams pa'i mchod pa rgyur byas pa las byung ba'i yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod sprin rab 'byams mkha' khyab tu spros te/ me tog dam pa sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// zhes dang me tog 'thor/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs bzla/ rol mo bya/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// zhes brjod pas lus dbul/ gsum pa ni/ bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba kun// nam mkha'i mthar thug sems can don gyi phyir// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mchog la 'bul lags na// 'gro kun byang chub myur du thob mdzad gsol// zhes dge ba'i rtsa ba dbul/ zhar byung de thams cad dang rjes su 'brel bar maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal so bdun ma dang*/ nyer gsum ma sogs spyi ltar la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid/ dpal rgyal ba byams pa mgon po 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad dga' ldan chos kyi 'dun sar dbugs dbyung ste/ myur du byang chub chen por lung bstan thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes dang*/ bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs bcas// rin chen maṇ+ḍal bzang po kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs bcas pa// blo yis blangs te ma pham mgon po 'khor dang bcas la dbul// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag lhag ma rnams ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar bzang spyod ltar bya'o// de ltar smon lam 'grub pa'i rgyu bsag sbyang spel gsum gyi gnas bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa grangs mang du bya/

gzungs bzla bar spro na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ shākya mu na ye/ ta thā ga tā ye/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a dzi te a dzi te/ a pa rā dzi te/ a dzi taṃ dza ya/ ha ra ha ra/ mai tri a wa lo ki te/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hā sa ma ya sid+dhi/ bha ra bha ra/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo bi dze/ sma ra sma ra/ asma skaṃ sa ma yaṃ/ bo dhi bo dhi/ ma hā bo dhi swā hā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so// oṃ mo hi mo hi/ ma hā mo hi swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ ma ti ma ti smṛ ti swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po ste/ de rnams ci nus bzlas nas/ smon lam gdab pa dngos ni/ gzhung rtsa ba las de nas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la 'di skad ces/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming rus 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bdag ming rus 'di zhes bgyi ba nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i sems can la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bgyi ba'i slad du dga' ldan du 'dug pa'i sems bskyed par bya ste/ bdag gis sbyin pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang*/ sgom pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag shi 'phos nas skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod par dga' ldan gyi gnas su dam pa'i chos la longs spyod par gyur cig ma'i mngal gyi rdzab tu mi skye zhing pad+ma'i sbubs su brdzus te skye bar gyur cig der yang sgrub pa'i rten phun sum tshogs pa chos brgyad dang ldan par gyur cig bla ma rje btsun byams pa mgon pos rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig

grogs byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su 'jug par gyur cig kun tu spyod pa'i sgo rnam par dag pa du mas de nyid mnyes par byed par gyur cig nam du'ang mi mnyes par byed par ma gyur cig bsam pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed par gyur cig sbyor ba pha rol tu phyin pa bcu yongs su rdzogs par byed par gyur cig spyod pa bla na med pa'i sgo drug mthar phyin par byed par gyur cig ched du bya ba gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa yul dus rnam pa thams cad du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du phan pa dang bde ba rgyas shing rgyun mi chad par gyur cig mdor na bdag dang gzhan gyi don thams cad 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par gyur cig bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /'di nas shi 'phos dga' ldan skye ba dang*// byams mgon bsten pas de dgongs rdzogs byed shog /ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor bar bya'o// slar yang smon lam de nyid 'grub pa'i don du dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa dang*// chos nyid mi 'gyur dri med dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa yi// bden pas smon lam 'grub par shog /ces dpon slob thams cad kyis me tog gtor bar bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ slar yang gtang rag gi tshul du/ me tog dam pa sogs mchod pa dang*/ spro na/ sngon tshe gser bzang 'od kyi rgyal ba las// zhes sogs kho bos byas pa'i thugs dam gnad nas skul ba'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal gang*// de yang bzod par mdzad du gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags/

mgon po ma pham pa la sogs pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams kyis bdag cag la sogs pa'i 'gro ba nyam thag pa rnams kyi don mdzad cing bka' drin stsal lags te/ da dung du'ang bdag cag rnams la thugs brtse bas yang dang yang du gdan 'dzoms par mdzad par dgongs shing*/ rang nyid kyi gdul bya'i zhing du gdul bya mang po'i don la gshegs par stsal du ci gnang*// zhes pas dga' ldan gyi zhing khams su slar yang gshegs par gsol/ sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs 'phags pa byams pa'i smon lam dang*/ spro zhing nus na khro phu lo tsā ba chen pos mdzad pa'i smon lam rin po che sil ma sogs kyang btab pa'i mthar/ che ba'i che mchog sogs bka' las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod cing me tog 'thor/ rol mo'i sgra snyan par sbyar bas dge legs su bya'o// de ltar brtson pa'i phan yon ni/ tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ dpal dang gzi brjid 'phel ba dang*/ tshul khrims dag cing gzungs thob pa dang*/ byang chub sems gnyis rtsol med du skye ba dang*/ 'chi 'phos nas kyang dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin gyi 'dun sar pad+ma'i snying po las brdzus te skyes nas myur du byang chub chen por lung bstan pa thob par 'gyur ba sogs mtha' yas pas na/ gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor gyis tshul 'di la brtson pa ni dal 'byor gyi rten la snying po len pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa yin no// dga' ba brgya ldan chos kyi pho brang du// smon lam gdab pa'i cho ga rmad byung ba// nor bu'i them skas 'dir brten yid can kun// sku gsum grong khyer mchog tu 'jug gyur cig /ces pa'ang tshul 'di la mos pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas rab gsal gyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ kha che'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī bha dra'i gsung ngag khro phu lo tsā ba chen po byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'i gzhung ji lta ba/

'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bklags pas grub par bsdebs pa dge legs mchog tu 'gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
